lessonTitle: 36. The function y = kx and its graph
lessonTitleEnglish: The function y = kx and its graph
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 7 mathematics textbooks

stages.headline: y = kx (k ≠ 0) is direct proportionality; its graph is a straight line through the origin.
stages.headlineEnglish: y = kx (k ≠ 0) is direct proportionality; its graph is a straight line through the origin.

stages.headline: k is the slope; for k > 0 the line passes through quadrants I and III, for k < 0 through II and IV.
stages.headlineEnglish: k is the slope; for k > 0 the line passes through quadrants I and III, for k < 0 through II and IV.

stages.headline: The larger |k| is, the steeper the line.
stages.headlineEnglish: The larger |k| is, the steeper the line.
